sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller
sections.section_title: Programming guidelines for receive idle and
sections.text_helper: Section 48.9.16 "Programming guidelines for receive idle and" in chapter 48 (Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2250.
sections.section_content:
receive interrupt watchdog timers
Programming guidelines for the receive idle timer
Follow these steps to enable the receive idle timer.
1. Program the ITW[4:0] bitfield of the Channel 0 Rx interrupt watchdog timer register
(ETH_DMAC0RXIWTR) with a nonzero value to enable the Idle timer.
2. Use the ITCU[1:0] bitfield of the Channel 0 Rx interrupt watchdog timer register
(ETH_DMAC0RXIWTR) to define the number of application clock cycles per unit in the
ITW[4:0] bitfield.
3. Program the ITW[4:0] bitfield of the Channel 0 Rx interrupt watchdog timer register
(ETH_DMAC0RXIWTR) for a given channel to check the trigger condition for the Idle
timer.
4. Program the RIE bit of the Channel 0 interrupt enable register (ETH_DMAC0IER) to a
timer value of ITW×ITCU application clock cycles.
Programming guidelines for the receive interrupt watchdog timer
Follow these steps to enable the receive interrupt watchdog timer.
1. Set the PSEL bit of the Channel 0 Rx interrupt watchdog timer register
(ETH_DMAC0RXIWTR) to set the receive watchdog timer to operate in received
packet counter mode.
2. Clear the PSEL bit of the Channel 0 Rx interrupt watchdog timer register
(ETH_DMAC0RXIWTR) to set the timer to operate in received byte counter mode.
3. Program the RBCT[9:0] bitfield of the Channel 0 Rx interrupt watchdog timer register
(ETH_DMAC0RXIWTR) with a nonzero value to set the byte-per-packet threshold for
the receive watchdog timer.
Programming guidelines for descriptor refetch when the OWN bit is cleared
The descriptor refetch checks the value of the OWN bit twice before the DMA engine enters
Suspend mode.
To enable the refetch on both the transmit and receive sides, set the DRO bit of the Channel
0 control register (ETH_DMAC0CR).
